activities.title: Brutus · the new first stop
intro: 8 points without rare drops; use normal Brutus.
Recommended stats: 30+ Magic or 40+ melee; 43 Prayer makes the naked kill comfortable

Wear / pack: For ordinary kills: your strongest basic melee or earth spell, armour, food and a teleport. For the naked kill, every equipment slot must be empty. Bring earth-spell runes in inventory and manually cast; prayers and runes are allowed. Carry the cowbell, but do not equip it during Beef vs Beef.
Smarter than a Cow means no attack attempted, even a 0. Protection alone will not award it. If obstacle control feels awkward, take the other five points and select a reserve.
steps: Unlock: finish the short Ides of Milk quest in the preparation appendix. Return to Gillie for the cowbell. Enter the northeastern pen in the Lumbridge cow field; choose normal Brutus.

Make a normal kill first. Stay healthy. A growl warns of a charge: move two tiles sideways. A snort warns of slams: step one tile backward or two sideways, then repeat for the follow-ups. Specials bypass ordinary protection.

Naked attempt: remove everything, including ammunition, jewellery and cowbell. Cast an earth spell manually from inventory runes. Do not consume anything until he dies. Alternatively punch with Melee protection. Eating before the fight is fine.

No-attack attempt: use ranged/Magic around a plant, trough, rock or sign. Keep enough obstacle distance that he cannot melee you. If he growls, dodge sideways; when he huffs and finds a path, reposition around the obstacle before he attacks. A permanent standstill safespot is not assumed.
Complete ten post-quest kills. Ring the cowbell immediately after the death message to accelerate respawn. Bank freely. Verify each task popup before checking it.

tasks.name: Brutus Novice
tasks.condition: Defeat normal Brutus after the quest.
tasks.tip: The quest bull is not a post-quest boss KC. Use earth spells or ordinary melee.

tasks.name: Beef vs Beef
tasks.condition: Win with every worn slot empty and no food or potion consumed during the fight.
tasks.tip: Manually cast earth spells with inventory runes, or punch while praying Melee. Jewellery/ammo count as equipment; remove the cowbell.

tasks.name: Smarter than a Cow
tasks.condition: Win without Brutus attempting an attack against you.
tasks.tip: Cast around an obstacle; move when he paths around it. A melee attempt hitting 0 still fails. Do this separately from the naked attempt while learning.

tasks.name: Brutus Champion
tasks.condition: Record ten post-quest Brutus kills.
tasks.tip: Use the cowbell promptly after the death message to shorten respawn. Ten kills total, not ten additional kills.

activities.label: Brutus

activities.title: Scurrius · five reliable points
intro: Do ten private kills; a spine is a bonus, not a prerequisite.
Recommended stats: 50+ Attack, Strength and Defence; 43 Prayer; 50+ HP recommended

Wear / pack: Melee weapon and armour, strength amulet if owned, 2–4 prayer potions for a first short trip, 12–18 food, teleport. Bank between kills as needed. Standard melee is enough; no ratbane weapon is assumed.
steps: Bank in Varrock, enter the sewer manhole east of the palace, then follow the rat area to Scurrius’ gate. Choose a private instance. Turn on auto-retaliate only if it does not interfere with your movement.
Fight in melee with Protect from Melee. Move immediately off the falling-brick shadow onto a clear tile; do not click back into the old shadow to resume damage.

When he eats at the food piles, protect against the projectile he launches: fur is ranged, electricity is Magic. Their checks occur on impact, so react to the visible projectile. During the final low-HP phase he remains central and fires these more frequently.

Ignore or kill giant rats as convenient; their small chip hits do not invalidate the specified Perfect Scurrius conditions. Make a private kill with correct overheads and no tail/rubble damage, then continue to ten KC across as many bank trips as needed.
If a spine drops, use the optional ratbane tasks below. The bone weapon’s no-delay attacks on adds let you click six rats in succession. No spine by ten kills? Continue the guide.

tasks.name: Scurrius Novice
tasks.condition: Record one Scurrius kill.
tasks.tip: Enter the private encounter from the gate; this is also the required version for Perfect.

tasks.name: Perfect Scurrius
tasks.condition: Private kill: dodge tail/rubble damage and use the correct protection for both projectile styles.
tasks.tip: Keep Melee near him; switch to Missiles for fur and Magic for electricity before impact. Rat minion chip damage is not part of this task.

tasks.name: Scurrius Champion
tasks.condition: Reach ten Scurrius kills.
tasks.tip: Bank freely; the task has no same-trip restriction. Stop at ten unless you want combat training.

tasks.name: Sit Rat
tasks.condition: Land the private-instance finishing blow with a ratbane weapon.
tasks.tip: Only if a spine drops. Mace needs rune mace + spine and 35 Smithing, or Aldo’s 50k service. Wield at 50 Attack.

tasks.name: Efficient Pest Control
tasks.condition: Defeat six giant rat adds inside a three-second window.
tasks.tip: With a ratbane weapon, kill the rats with consecutive clicks; its add attack delay is removed. Do not grind a spine solely for this task.

activities.label: Scurrius

activities.title: Wintertodt · thirteen points, not a 99 grind
intro: One long solo plus short wins; stop at ten subdues.
Recommended stats: 50 Firemaking required; any HP level

Wear / pack: Axe, tinderbox, hammer, four recognised warm pieces, a few food and rejuvenation drinks. Knife if fletching. Beginner warm choices: rainbow scarf from Diango, Clue hunter gloves/boots dug north of Ardougne with a spade, and fire staff from Zaff. Confirm four warm items in the encounter interface; ordinary red armour is not automatically warm.
Wintertodt now uses warmth . Rejuvenation restores warmth; zero warmth is dangerous. There is no reason to preserve 10 Hitpoints for this guide. Keep at least 500 score in short wins.
steps: From Port Piscarilius or another Kourend landing, reach the Wintertodt camp in northern Great Kourend. Bank supplies outside. Equip four verified warm items, and take axe, tinderbox, hammer and food. In the entrance lobby, take unfinished rejuvenation potions from the crates and bruma herbs from the sprouting roots. Combine them after Druidic Ritual, or use the ingredients on Brew’ma to make them without that quest. Inspect the encounter’s warm-item count.

On a quiet world for the long attempt, light the braziers to reduce Wintertodt’s energy, then use one brazier to slow the finish. Chop bruma roots, optionally fletch, and feed them. Repair when broken and heal the pyromancer with rejuvenation.

For Why Fletch? , deliberately prolong the solo to 3,000 personal score before finishing. Keep energy low enough to control the encounter and your warmth well above zero. If energy is falling too quickly, allow the active brazier to go out temporarily while gathering roots; repair/heal before resuming.

For Mummy! , allow one pyromancer to fall, revive with rejuvenation, then win. On a different run, heal early so none falls for Leaving No One Behind. Repair all vulnerable braziers before the last one breaks for Can We Fix It?

Finish ten rounds total. Public activity worlds are a faster option for the short KC tail and still normal Ironman play; use a quiet solo for the 3,000-score attempt. Strictly solo players can do every run solo, at higher time cost.

tasks.name: Cosy
tasks.condition: Win while wearing four items recognised as warm.
tasks.tip: Check the warm-item count; the Clue hunter helm is an exception and is not warm.

tasks.name: Handyman
tasks.condition: Repair a brazier after Wintertodt breaks it.
tasks.tip: Carry a hammer and click the broken brazier. Relighting an intact extinguished one does not satisfy repair.

tasks.name: Mummy!
tasks.condition: Revive a pyromancer that has already fallen.
tasks.tip: Use rejuvenation potion on the downed NPC, then finish. This cannot share a run with Leaving No One Behind.

tasks.name: Wintertodt Novice
tasks.condition: Reach five successful Wintertodt subdues.
tasks.tip: Get at least 500 score in each counted run and finish the round.

tasks.name: Can We Fix It?
tasks.condition: Win a run in which all four braziers are never broken together.
tasks.tip: Broken differs from simply unlit. Repair before the last working brazier breaks; busy public games often earn this naturally.

tasks.name: Leaving No One Behind
tasks.condition: Win with no pyromancer falling during that run.
tasks.tip: Use a separate attempt from Mummy! Heal low NPC health early; in a solo, manage the one you are using.

tasks.name: Why Fletch?
tasks.condition: Win with at least 3,000 personal encounter score.
tasks.tip: Prolong one solo safely: keep one brazier working and repair/heal it. Watch warmth, not an old 10-HP damage formula.

tasks.name: Wintertodt Champion
tasks.condition: Reach ten Wintertodt wins.
tasks.tip: The long 3,000-score run is one of the ten. No need to continue to 99 Firemaking.

activities.label: Wintertodt

activities.title: Tempoross · eight points with basic tools
intro: Use a simple three-phase solo; leave the 10-permit challenge out of the baseline.
Recommended stats: 35 Fishing required; no combat requirement

Wear / pack: Harpoon, rope, hammer, 4–5 buckets; tools are provided at the ruins. Fill buckets at the pump. Keep rope and hammer across attempts. No angler outfit, dragon harpoon, Imcando hammer or barbarian fishing required.
The task named Why Cook? needs ten permits in one game —8,300 score guarantees that count. Basic clean solos are not enough by themselves. It is deliberately omitted from the default basket.
steps: Take Ferryman Sathwood’s boat south of Al Kharid bank to the Ruins of Unkah. Collect basic tools and fill buckets. Right-click the boarding ladder and use Solo-start for The Lone Angler; a mass is fine for ordinary KC. At 35 Fishing, a few public games first build levels and teach warnings before the solo attempt; strictly solo players can practise all runs alone.

Fish harpoonfish, cook on the island shrine, then load a ship’s cannon to reduce the energy bar. For a basic-tools solo, 18 cooked fish in total take a full energy bar to zero . Fish/cook a batch and load it promptly. Do not wait past roughly 90–93% storm intensity to leave the cooking shrine; if short, deliver the cooked fish you have first and finish the missing amount immediately. Energy below 10% suppresses further specials until the down phase.

On a wave warning, stop and tether to a mast/totem using the rope. Remain tethered until it passes. Douse fires before crossing them; move away from the torrent striking a cannon. At zero energy, run to the spirit pool and harpoon Tempoross until it rises again.

Repeat fishing/cooking/loading and spirit fishing over the next phases. Do not use a rigid high-level inventory rotation if you cannot hold it; deliver early rather than letting storm reach 100%. With basic 35 Fishing, allow extra practice and phases. Use double-fish spots when available.

One run: douse at least five fires and repair a damaged mast/totem. A separate utility run: distribute fish into all four cannons across both ships; refill and cross via the island while watching storm/waves. If doing this in a public game, act early before it finishes.
Win one clean Solo-start with no hazard hits. Reach ten wins total. Tools can be lost to waves/fire; replace them before retrying. This encounter has no ordinary HP-death penalty.
For Why Cook?, use the exact task link for a dedicated high-score solo. Pick up the ordinary tools at the cove. A dragon harpoon is optional.

tasks.name: Calm Before the Storm
tasks.condition: Repair a damaged mast or totem during the encounter.
tasks.tip: Hammer needed. After the wave, repair a damaged anchor point.

tasks.name: Master of Buckets
tasks.condition: Put out five or more fire tiles in one encounter.
tasks.tip: Fill several buckets at the pump and douse five different burning tiles. Refill as needed.

tasks.name: Fire in the Hole!
tasks.condition: Load each of the four cannons, spread across both ships, in the same encounter.
tasks.tip: One load per cannon suffices. Cross via the island and complete this in a separate run if the detour spoils your solo timing.

tasks.name: The Lone Angler
tasks.condition: Win a solo without fire, torrent or wave hits.
tasks.tip: Use Solo-start, tether before each wave and leave storm-marked cannon positions. A public mass cannot award the solo condition.

tasks.name: Tempoross Novice
tasks.condition: Reach five successful Tempoross games.
tasks.tip: Normal practice wins count; no outfit required.

tasks.name: Tempoross Champion
tasks.condition: Reach ten successful Tempoross games.
tasks.tip: Ten cumulative wins, not ten additional games after Novice.

tasks.name: Dress Like You Mean It
tasks.condition: Subdue Tempoross wearing four Angler or Spirit Angler pieces. Mixed sets count.
tasks.tip: Use an outfit already owned. Fishing Trawler outfit acquisition is a poor detour for three points.

tasks.name: Why Cook?
tasks.condition: Subdue Tempoross and earn ten reward permits from the same game.
tasks.tip: After learning solo Tempoross, try a high-score solo: 8,300 points guarantees ten permits. Cook fish, manage storm intensity and extend the run using the linked firefighting or five-round method.

activities.label: Tempoross

activities.title: Kourend · giants and a demon
intro: Six points; do not train Slayer solely for one-point tasks.
Recommended stats: 40+ combat skills; 37–43 Prayer recommended; basic Magic for safespots

Wear / pack: Basic melee gear plus Silverlight from Demon Slayer I, air/fire runes for safespotting, food, teleport and anti-dragon shield. The shield is required for the black-dragon visit unless safely out of dragonfire range; obtain it after starting Dragon Slayer I. A dust-free light source is irrelevant here.
Save the Taverley targets for the Asgarnian phase to avoid another cross-map return.
steps: Use a Kourend trip to visit the Giants’ Den southwest of Shayzien. Kill one hill giant, one moss giant and one fire giant inside it; ranged/Magic around cave obstacles works. This yields Into the Den plus the separate fire-giant task.

At Chasm of Fire’s middle level, fight a greater demon from a safe edge/obstacle. Reduce it to low HP, then finish with Silverlight . You receive the ordinary greater-demon task and its demonbane-finisher task. Demon Slayer I is the small quest prerequisite; see the preparation notes.

tasks.name: Into the Den of Giants
tasks.condition: Defeat a hill, moss and fire giant inside the Shayzien Giants’ Den.
tasks.tip: Use the cave southwest of Shayzien. The three species must be killed in this particular cave.

tasks.name: The Walking Volcano
tasks.condition: Defeat a fire giant.
tasks.tip: The Den fire giant used for the preceding task also satisfies this.

tasks.name: A Greater Foe
tasks.condition: Defeat one greater demon.
tasks.tip: Use a safe non-Wilderness location such as Chasm of Fire’s middle level.

tasks.name: Not So Great After All
tasks.condition: Finish a greater demon with a demonbane weapon.
tasks.tip: Use Silverlight for the final hit after weakening it. A normal sword or a fire spell cannot replace the finishing weapon.

activities.label: Kourend creatures

activities.title: Chambers rooms · optional reserve
intro: Group reserve. Get familiar with the rooms with your group. Ironmen must deal all damage to their chosen Guardian, and the Ice Demon kill-credit tasks use solo attempts. A teammate dealing the damage cannot award those tasks for you.
Recommended stats: 40 Attack for a rune pickaxe; 35+ Magic (59 faster); 40 Prayer for Missiles; 50+ HP

Wear / pack: Strongest pickaxe you can wield, axe, tinderbox, hammer, melee armour, magic robes, fire-spell runes, bow + ammo, melee weapon, food and 2–4 prayer potions. Bank separate kits for separate rooms. Normal mode, extra scaling 0, solo party.
Start with the puzzle or a room you already know. Use the exact combat achievement rules to determine whose damage counts. These points are optional.
steps: Reach Mount Quidamortem by a 20-coin Kourend minecart trip or by walking west from Shayzien’s Wall. Speak to the Mountain Guide once to unlock the two-way path. Bank at the raid entrance.

Create a solo party at the board, select normal Chambers and leave extra scaling at 0 . Enter and inspect the first accessible room. Right-click the entrance stairs → Reload to reroll. Seek Guardians, Ice Demon and crabs separately; do not traverse a whole raid for this guide.

Guardian, 4 points: wield your strongest usable pickaxe, select Smash, hit a single guardian, immediately run at least two tiles away. Repeat. Rocks cover a 3×3 area around their target, so a one-tile sidestep is insufficient. Melee protection is helpful, but the condition specifically forbids rock damage. One personally killed guardian awards the task.

Ice Demon, first kill, 8 points: chop kindling and feed/light the room braziers until the storm thaws. Turn on Protect from Missiles: this forces the slower visible boulder. Cast a fire spell, run at least two tiles away from the landing position, cast again from clear ground. Keep Prayer up, take zero damage, and use fire for the finishing hit. If damaged, bank the fire task and retry only the perfect task.

Second demon, 4 points: never activate Protect from Missiles during this attempt. Magic protection is allowed; its attacks can be harder to read. Keep moving between casts and eat as needed. This task permits damage, so it need not be combined with Cryo No More.

Crabs, 5 points: use the colour table and routing rules below. With auto-retaliate off, lure crabs to the route junctions. Every crab turns the orb 90° clockwise. A white orb takes a crab’s colour when it touches it. Hammer-smash holds a crab temporarily; the hammer also turns it red, so restore the required attack-style colour close to the orb’s arrival.

Practice the route before solving the first crystal. After that first success, every later orb must activate an unsolved crystal: no catching it yourself, wrong colour, missed crystal or already-solved target. Some layouts cannot be handled comfortably solo; reload rather than force one. The layout varies, so no fictional universal tile diagram is supplied.

Room-task completion is permanent on the CA popup. Reload/leave; no Olm or raid completion is required. A regular Ironman Chambers death does not delete worn/carried normal equipment, though dropped items can disappear with the instance.

tasks.name: Dancing with Statues
tasks.condition: Get your own Stone Guardian kill-credit without rock-fall damage.
tasks.tip: For Ironman credit, deal all damage to your chosen Guardian yourself. A teammate can take the other one separately. Use your own suitable pickaxe and avoid falling rocks.

tasks.name: Kill It with Fire
tasks.condition: Use a fire spell for the Ice Demon’s final damage.
tasks.tip: Finish the thawed demon with Fire Bolt/Blast. Your own solo kill awards this without Olm or a completed raid.

tasks.name: Cryo No More
tasks.condition: Get solo Ice Demon kill-credit with no damage taken.
tasks.tip: Protect Missiles forces a slow visible boulder; cast then move at least two tiles off its target. Prayer alone does not meet the task.

tasks.name: Blizzard Dodger
tasks.condition: Get Ice Demon kill-credit without ever activating Protect from Missiles in that attempt.
tasks.tip: Do this in a separate solo kill-credit attempt without Protect from Missiles. Use your own spells and supplies. Damage is allowed for this task.

tasks.name: Playing with Lasers
tasks.condition: Solve the crabs with no wasted orb after the first crystal activates.
tasks.tip: Plan before the first solve; use the colour table below. Some solo layouts are awkward or infeasible: reload for a workable room. Failure means another room attempt, not a lost raid completion.

activities.label: Chambers rooms
activities.groupOption: Arrange help learning the rooms. Keep the task’s own kill-credit rules.

activities.title: Sarachnis · approach after each web
intro: Take the 8-point mechanics ceiling first; 25 KC adds only three more points.
Recommended stats: 60+ melee, 60+ Defence and 43 Prayer; 65+ HP helpful

Wear / pack: Rune mace or another decent crush weapon; a dragon mace if Heroes’ Quest is already complete. Best melee armour, knife or slashing weapon for webs, several prayer potions, food and a teleport. Do not grind a cudgel for this guide.
steps: Walk to Forthos Ruins west of Hosidius, enter the dungeon and head south to the burial area. Cut the small webs using a knife/slashing weapon. Peek through the thick web; choose an empty world.

Stand beside Sarachnis near the centre and use Protect from Melee. Use the rune mace’s crush style; Spike is stab. Finish with a crush attack for Newspaper Enthusiast; other styles earlier are allowed.

After four ordinary attacks she webs you and moves away. Switch to Protect from Missiles while rooted. As soon as released, run to her and switch back to Melee on contact. Eating while rooted loses less attack time.

At roughly two-thirds and one-third HP, spiderlings appear. At low stats, kill the blue Magic spider promptly while maintaining the prayer for the boss. Ignore a melee add while your Melee prayer is protecting you. Do not camp Magic prayer and let the boss hit you unprotected.

A clean kill finished on crush can stack Newspaper, Inspect Repellent and Ready to Pounce. Add damage is distinct from Sarachnis herself damaging you. If she fires twice because you stayed at range, retry Ready on the next kill.
Reach ten, then—only if still worthwhile—twenty-five kills. Bank between short trips. The last fifteen kills buy only two points; substitute rather than force an inefficient tail.

tasks.name: Newspaper Enthusiast
tasks.condition: Finish Sarachnis with a crush-style attack.
tasks.tip: Use rune mace on Pound/Pummel/Block for the final hit. Spike is stab. Other damage styles earlier in the fight are allowed.

tasks.name: Ready to Pounce
tasks.condition: Win without Sarachnis using two ranged attacks consecutively.
tasks.tip: After a web, switch Missiles while stuck, then approach immediately and switch Melee at contact. Never wait at distance for another ranged hit.

tasks.name: Inspect Repellent
tasks.condition: Finish a kill during which Sarachnis damages nobody.
tasks.tip: Her blocked hits count as no damage; spiderling damage is separate. Kill the blue magic add to conserve food while maintaining boss prayers.

tasks.name: Sarachnis Novice
tasks.condition: Reach ten Sarachnis kills.
tasks.tip: Return to a bank whenever necessary. No streak requirement.

tasks.name: Sarachnis Champion
tasks.condition: Reach twenty-five total Sarachnis kills.
tasks.tip: The last fifteen add only two points. Swap this tail if a faster reserve is available.

activities.label: Sarachnis

activities.title: Deranged Archaeologist · the non-Wilderness one
intro: 4 mechanics points on a clean magic kill, 5 at 10 KC, 7 at 25.
Recommended stats: 50+ Magic, 40 Prayer and 60+ HP recommended

Wear / pack: Staff + runes for your best affordable spell, magic robes, prayer restoration, food and teleport. Carry enough food to survive a mistake; direct special damage can reach 56. No melee or ranged damage for Mage of the Swamp.
steps: After Bone Voyage, take the Digsite barge to Fossil Island. Carry an axe, rake and antipoison . Walk southwest through Sticky Swamp, cut the thick vine, rake the small vines and pass the spined mushroom. Cure poison if necessary. The Sticky Swamp mushtree is a convenience only if already unlocked.
Before climbing the decaying trunk into the arena, activate Protect from Missiles. Stand at casting distance and deal Magic damage only.

When he shouts Learn to Read! , stop casting and run toward the opposite diagonal corner, around nine tiles from the old position. Let the whole book chain explode before returning. Adjacent books mean a tiny sidestep is not a safe default.
One clean kill awards both mechanic tasks. Complete ten for the easy KC point; extend to twenty-five for two additional points only after comparing accessible alternatives.
Teleport or leave the trunk before running out of food/Prayer. The direct special can hit 56, and neighboring explosions can combine with it. Do not test an avoidable hit at low HP.

tasks.name: Mage of the Swamp
tasks.condition: Defeat Deranged Archaeologist using only Magic.
tasks.tip: Fossil Island, not the Wilderness boss. Avoid recoil/thralls/other attacks while doing a strict style task.

tasks.name: I'd Rather Be Illiterate
tasks.condition: Win with no player hit by the Learn to Read book special.
tasks.tip: Run a large diagonal, about nine tiles, immediately on the shout. Standing two tiles away can still be hit by adjacent books.

tasks.name: Deranged Archaeologist Novice
tasks.condition: Reach ten Deranged Archaeologist kills.
tasks.tip: Ten total gives the easy KC point in addition to mechanics.

tasks.name: Deranged Archaeologist Champion
tasks.condition: Reach twenty-five total Deranged Archaeologist kills.
tasks.tip: Fifteen extra for two points; use only while faster available activities are exhausted.

activities.label: Deranged Archaeologist

activities.title: Barrows · all seven tasks, in separate runs
intro: Front-load the mechanic runs; extra chest KC is a slow fallback before the hilt.
Recommended stats: 50+ Magic, 43 Prayer, 60+ HP; 60 Attack + Lost City only for the dagger task

Wear / pack: Spade, air staff and air-combat spell runes, Bind/Snare runes, magic kit, melee/ranged option for Ahrim, food, prayer potions and a teleport. For Just Like That: dragon dagger (Lost City + 60 Attack). Protection prayers are not used on the separate Faithless run.
steps: Reach Mort’ton/Barrows via the walking route in the map below. A Shades of Mort’ton grouping teleport is available only if you meet its own access rules; a swamp-boat BKR route needs Nature Spirit. You may instead walk the Mort Myre path with supplies. Bank before departure, take a spade, and learn the mound layout: Dharok northeast, Verac northwest, Ahrim centre, Guthan southeast, Karil south, Torag southwest.

Dig on a mound, descend, activate the correct protection before opening the coffin, then kill the brother. One coffin leads to the tunnels. Wind Bolt/Blast is suitable because the brothers now have an air weakness; keep your Magic attack high enough to avoid automatic splashing.

Coffin control: turn auto-retaliate off, land Bind/Snare, run to the opposite long side of the coffin and cast across it. Reposition before the root wears off. Do all four melee brothers this way for Can’t Touch Me; allowing an attack that hits 0 still fails. If a melee brother is your tunnel brother, trap him behind a closed door/ladder obstruction instead.

No-damage run: protect against the other brothers and stop all Verac contact with binds/terrain. Verac can bypass prayer; merely praying Melee is not enough. At the tunnel, avoid brother contact, solve the matching-shape door puzzle, defeat the sixth brother and loot. Ordinary tunnel-monster hits do not count as brother damage.

Zero-Prayer run, separately: start at 0 Prayer, never restore it. Safespot the four melee brothers and tank Ahrim/Karil at healthy HP with appropriate defensive gear/food. Use Magic only for an easy brother kill if the magic-only task is still missing. Ahrim/Karil are not stopped by the melee door safespot.

Karil specials, separately: with Lost City and 60 Attack, use dragon dagger specials only. Turn auto-retaliate off and do not leave an ordinary attack queued. If four specials are insufficient, stay alive under Missiles protection while energy regenerates, then special again. No other source may damage Karil.

The tunnel puzzle asks for the next shape in its repeating rotation/sequence. Choose the next shape before an aggressive monster interrupts you; clear an attacker first if needed. Search the chest, confirm task notifications, then teleport and restore.

Looting the chest resets a failed run’s task tracking; leaving/re-entering alone is insufficient. Reach ten or twenty-five chests only if their marginal points still beat your reserves. The main objective is to gain the hilt before a long Barrows grind.

tasks.name: Defence? What Defence?
tasks.condition: Defeat any Barrows brother using Magic damage only.
tasks.tip: Wind spells exploit their air weakness. One suitable ordinary kill can earn it; no Iban’s unlock needed.

tasks.name: Can't Touch Me
tasks.condition: Defeat all four melee brothers without any of them attempting a melee attack.
tasks.tip: Bind/snare and keep the coffin between you. A protected 0-hit still fails; reset by looting the chest.

tasks.name: Pray for Success
tasks.condition: Defeat all six brothers and loot with no brother damage in the run.
tasks.tip: Protect against Ahrim/Karil/Dharok etc., but safespot/bind Verac because prayer is not fully reliable against him. Tunnel-monster damage is separate.

tasks.name: Faithless Crypt Run
tasks.condition: Clear all six brothers and loot while Prayer never rises above zero.
tasks.tip: Start at 0; no potion/altar/restore. Use coffins/doors to stop melee brothers and tank Ahrim/Karil carefully at healthy HP. Do a separate run from prayer-based tasks.

tasks.name: Just Like That
tasks.condition: Deal all of Karil’s damage with special attacks.
tasks.tip: Dragon dagger after Lost City. If one full bar fails to finish him, defend/restore Prayer and wait for more special energy; never add a regular hit. Put an already-owned special weapon in the profile.

tasks.name: Barrows Novice
tasks.condition: Open ten Barrows chests.
tasks.tip: Open a chest per run. This is cumulative and can share your mechanic runs.

tasks.name: Barrows Champion
tasks.condition: Open twenty-five Barrows chests.
tasks.tip: The last fifteen grant two more points; stop this early if you reach 169 elsewhere.

activities.label: Barrows

activities.title: Theatre Entry · optional reserve
intro: This route waits for A Night at the Theatre to confirm that you have finished the quest and learned a clear. Its quest path starts after A Taste of Hope.
The quest may use a full Entry Mode clear. The Anticoagulants and They Won’t Expect This achievements themselves are room tasks, so a separate full clear is unnecessary for those awards.
Choose Entry Mode. Bring your own usable ranged weapon and ammunition, armour, prayer restoration and food. The quest clear needs three combat styles and a separate later-room kit.
steps: From Canifis, follow the Haunted Woods/Port Phasmatys coastal route south to Ver Sinhaza; paying Andras 10,000 coins north of Ectofuntus saves some travel to Slepe. No A Taste of Hope teleport is assumed. Bank at Ver Sinhaza.

Arrange a party for the guide’s reserve, select Entry Mode at the board and agree which players handle each room condition. Keep your own kit ready. For the quest clear, follow the full Entry Mode guide including the later rooms.

Maiden: activate Protect from Magic before entry. Attack from range; after each shot, move at least three tiles from the old position before blood lands. Never stand in blood puddles because they hurt you and heal her.

At HP thresholds, kill small red healers walking toward her. More importantly for this task, immediately kill every wandering bloodspawn within ten seconds of appearing. These trail blood and are not the same as the red healers. No spawn appearing also satisfies the condition.

After Maiden dies, confirm Anticoagulants. Continue to the Bloat room’s outer corridor. Before crossing into combat , walk all the way round to the opposite entry barrier, wait until Bloat is away, then cross there. They Won’t Expect This awards on entry; do not fight him just for this task.

Once the selected room tasks award, use the raid’s leave or resign controls between rooms if that is your plan. Ordinary teleports do not work inside Theatre. A death can remove Hardcore status or a group life even with unlimited Entry Mode retries.

tasks.name: Anticoagulants
tasks.condition: Defeat Entry Maiden without a bloodspawn surviving longer than ten seconds.
tasks.tip: Pray Magic, move off blood, shoot each wandering bloodspawn immediately. Red healers are different adds. No bloodspawns spawning is also valid; no full raid required.

tasks.name: They Won't Expect This
tasks.condition: Enter Entry Bloat’s arena through the side opposite the room’s usual entrance.
tasks.tip: Walk the outer corridor before crossing a combat barrier. The task awards on entry; no Bloat kill or full Theatre needed.

tasks.name: Appropriate Tools
tasks.condition: Defeat Entry Bloat while every player wears a salve amulet.
tasks.tip: Any salve variant; solo satisfies every-player wording. Only add this if you own a salve or accept Haunted Mine’s additional preparation.

sources.label: A Night at the Theatre quest and unlocks

activities.label: Theatre Entry
activities.groupOption: Bring a prepared party. These tasks are in Entry Mode.

activities.title: Amoxliatl · fourteen points if unlocked
intro: Eight points on one clean kill, then ten in a trip and twenty total.
Recommended stats: 60+ melee, 37+ Prayer (43 recommended), 60+ HP

Wear / pack: Best ordinary melee weapon, melee armour, prayer potions sized from your observed ten-kill cost (potentially 8–12 at low Prayer), 12–18 food and teleport. Enter the streak at full HP/prayer. A temotli is not required; do not grind it for two points.
steps: If The Heart of Darkness is incomplete, compare its missing 55 Mining/48 Thieving/48 Slayer/46 Agility time with the reserve alternatives before committing. Complete the appendix quest steps when it is worthwhile.

From Salvager Overlook, head southeast to the Twilight Temple; alternatively fly to Quetzacalli Gorge and walk through the gate. Use the post-quest lift shortcut you activated. Enter with full Prayer and Protect from Magic.
After each ordinary spell, move at least two tiles onto clear ground; the old target becomes ice. Attack again to draw the boss with you. Do not immediately return to the previous icy square.

Unstable ice: smash every spawned block with melee before the nine-second deadline. The quick guaranteed hits make consecutive clicks effective. An expired block damages/heals and spoils Totally Shattered. Eating just after smashing can save attack time.
Icicle Crash: your active prayers turn off. Reactivate Protect from Magic before the projectile arrives. Floor ice is still dangerous while correctly praying.
One clean kill can award Champion, Totally Shattered and Nagua Negation for eight points. Bank after learning rather than forcing a streak with an unsuitable inventory.

For ten in one visit, measure Prayer doses per kill at your own speed/bonus. Pack ten times that cost plus a margin; with low Prayer and slow kills, 8–12 full prayer potions may be needed. Leave food/teleport space. No stepping outside for moths. Complete twenty total kills across trips for Adept.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Champion
tasks.condition: Defeat Amoxliatl once after the quest.
tasks.tip: Normal Magic attacks: Protect Magic, then move off the icy tile and draw her forward.

tasks.name: Totally Shattered
tasks.condition: Win without an unstable-ice block expiring and shattering.
tasks.tip: Smash every spawned block with melee inside nine seconds. Do not chase DPS while a block remains.

tasks.name: Nagua Negation
tasks.condition: Defeat Amoxliatl with no damage taken.
tasks.tip: Dodge floor ice, smash blocks, reactivate Protect Magic after Icicle Crash disables it. Can stack with the preceding tasks.

tasks.name: Kemo Makti
tasks.condition: Defeat ten Amoxliatl in one uninterrupted chamber visit.
tasks.tip: No stepping outside for moths. Measure one kill’s Prayer cost and pack ten times that plus margin; 8–12 full prayer potions may be needed with slow kills.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Adept
tasks.condition: Reach twenty post-quest Amoxliatl kills.
tasks.tip: Bank between trips except during the ten-kill streak; this is twenty total.

tasks.name: Temotli Triumph
tasks.condition: Use only glacial temotli as your weapon for a kill.
tasks.tip: Only if already owned; do not chase the 1/100 drop for two points.

tasks.name: Amoxliatl Speed-Trialist
tasks.condition: Finish an Amoxliatl kill strictly under one minute.
tasks.tip: A gear-dependent upgrade, not a guaranteed low-stat task. Limit attempts and use another reserve if damage is insufficient.

activities.label: Amoxliatl

activities.title: Moons · ten points without speed tasks
intro: One three-Moon chest, one no-supplies Blue, one clone-only Eclipse, five chests total.
Recommended stats: 60–65+ melee and Defence workable for a first clear; 70+ is substantially easier; 38 Herblore for local potions

Wear / pack: Highest-defence armour you own, melee weapon, a crush option for Blue, a high-hit 2h weapon for Eclipse clones, rope, net and pestle/mortar. Rune armour works but Blood can be hard at 60 Defence. Eat and drink before each entry. Protection prayers do not block Moon normal attacks.

These fights use generous local supplies but still have a 48 Slayer quest gate. If that unlock is several hours away and you need few points, use an already-open activity. The fast-Moon tasks below are reserves, not guaranteed beginner points.
steps: Complete Perilous Moons using the appendix. The main plan asks for only ten points, no speed threshold, thirty-kill streak or dragon-scimitar unlock . At approximately 60 Defence/rune, one Blood clear can be difficult; 70s are more comfortable, but do not train those levels solely because this chapter exists.

Use the dungeon camps for free food and Moonlight potions. Potion making needs 38 Herblore. Grind a collected moonlight grub, add paste to a vial of water. The potion’s boosts improve at higher Herblore; at 38 it is not a full super-combat potion. Fish/cook bream or catch/cook moss lizards, and eat to full before each room. Low Fishing/Hunter makes weaker food.
Normal phases: stand on the currently lit protective glyph and move with it. Wear defence. Protection prayers do not block these normal attacks; ordinary melee stat prayers can help.

Blue: use crush. If your weapon freezes, hit the blue-glowing block with your fists, step off the ice-shard warning, repeat until broken, then re-equip. During the storm, relight both extinguished braziers while avoiding tornadoes; footprints show safe edges. For Fortified, eat/pot before entry and consume nothing until this Moon dies. Heal and retry if unsafe.

Eclipse: keep the moving shield between you and the boss throughout its circuit. During clones, face each appearing clone by clicking the ground under/behind it. Correct facing parries automatically; a slow high-hit weapon is useful. For Clone Zone, auto-retaliate off and never attack the real Moon between clone phases. Wait through as many cycles as needed.

Blood: slash and high defence help. Eating does not heal the boss; its successful hits do. During blood rain, move off every pool and do not return to a lit glyph until its blood is gone. During jaguars, stand in the protected circle at the highlighted one; when the blood-pool animation finishes and disappears, step one tile away from the jaguar toward the boss, then step back to attack. Early steps hit blood, late steps hit claws. The initial siphon is expected.

Defeat all three and loot for Lunar Triplet. Work on a separate Blue no-consumables kill and Eclipse clone-only kill. Loot five chests total; after the first full clear, single-Moon chests are enough for the remaining count. Verify actual post-quest task credit rather than assuming the quest has awarded every CA.

tasks.name: Lunar Triplet
tasks.condition: Defeat all three Moons before looting one chest.
tasks.tip: Do one complete learning clear. Read all three special mechanics; protection prayers do not block ordinary Moon hits.

tasks.name: Fortified
tasks.condition: Defeat a Moon while consuming nothing inside its fight.
tasks.tip: Use Blue: full HP and a potion BEFORE entry, then no food/drink until victory. If low, eat and retry instead of dying.

tasks.name: The Clone Zone
tasks.condition: Defeat Eclipse while your attacks target only its clones.
tasks.tip: Auto-retaliate off; wait through normal attacks and shield phase, then face each appearing clone with a slow high-hit weapon.

tasks.name: Perilous Novice
tasks.condition: Loot the lunar chest five times.
tasks.tip: After the first all-three clear, you may use one-Moon chests for the remaining KC; there is no need to repeat Blood five times.

tasks.name: High Hitter
tasks.condition: Defeat any Moon before its second newly-started special begins.
tasks.tip: An in-progress special at entry is ignored. Enter just after one begins and use your best existing damage. Mark as a stretch if low stats.

tasks.name: Perilous Dancer
tasks.condition: In one three-Moon clear, take only normal-attack damage.
tasks.tip: Stay on active glyphs and avoid all specials. Blood’s initial jaguar siphon is allowed; pool/jaguar hits are not. Loot a chest to reset a failed attempt.

tasks.name: Moons of Peril Speed-Trialist
tasks.condition: Clear all three Moons in less than eight minutes.
tasks.tip: Separate from slow clone-only attempts. Use existing good gear; no forced stat/weapon grind.

tasks.name: Fat of the Land
tasks.condition: Defeat thirty individual Moons without leaving Neypotzli.
tasks.tip: Ten three-Moon rounds is one straightforward interpretation. Restock inside; count bosses, not chests. Leave only after notification.

tasks.name: Back to Our Roots
tasks.condition: Damage all three Moons only with a dragon scimitar during one clear.
tasks.tip: Requires Monkey Madness I + 60 Attack and an owned scimitar. No dagger special or 2h clone swap on this run.

tasks.name: Perilous Champion
tasks.condition: Open twenty-five lunar chests in total.
tasks.tip: Only a useful reserve if most KC is already done. Do not grind the whole tail for three points by default.

activities.label: Moons of Peril

activities.title: Taverley · two ordinary targets
intro: Do this while already in Asgarnia; skip the dragon if shield access is a large detour.
Recommended stats: 40+ combat skills; 37–43 Prayer recommended; basic Magic for safespots
Wear / pack: Food, teleport, basic Magic/ranged gear, anti-dragon shield for the adult black dragon, and dusty key if the shortcut is unavailable.
If these detours take longer than a nearby two- or three-point task, postpone them. The normal monsters are fillers, not reasons to train Slayer or a lengthy transport quest.
steps: Make a Taverley Dungeon circuit for a hellhound and an adult black dragon. If you lack the 70 Agility shortcut, get the dusty key from Velrak in the Black Knights’ prison to the south: kill the jailer, use his key, free Velrak and ask for a place to explore. Use the dusty key to pass the locked gate near the lesser demons and follow the full dungeon route north to the hellhound/black-dragon area.

Kill one hellhound with Melee prayer or a rock safespot. For the black dragon, wear an anti-dragon shield, stay at distance and use Magic/ranged behind the terrain. Confirm the target is an adult black dragon. Eat/teleport well before supplies run out.

tasks.name: A Demon's Best Friend
tasks.condition: Defeat one hellhound.
tasks.tip: Safespot in Taverley Dungeon if needed. Bring food for the dungeon approach.

tasks.name: Big, Black and Fiery
tasks.condition: Defeat a black dragon; baby dragons do not qualify.
tasks.tip: Use the adult Taverley dragon safespot and anti-dragon shield. Do not mistake a blue dragon for a black dragon.

activities.label: Taverley creatures

activities.title: Giant Mole · an eleven-point ceiling
intro: No Falador Hard diary grind. Retry mechanics during the 25-kill cap, then substitute if unlucky.
Recommended stats: 60+ melee, 43 Prayer; stronger damage reduces burrow randomness

Wear / pack: Spade, a lit light: an owned bullseye lantern is convenient (49 Firemaking); otherwise candles + tinderbox with immediate relighting, melee gear, 3–5 prayer potions, food, energy potions if available and teleport. A candle can be blown out and is unsuitable. Do not assume a mole locator.
steps: Bank in Falador and dig on a molehill in the west of Falador Park with a spade. Bring a lit light source. A bullseye lantern or Kandarin headgear is convenient if already owned; a cheap candle + tinderbox works if you relight immediately after burrows. Do not unlock a long quest solely for a lamp.
Keep Protect from Melee on throughout. Fight with your best melee weapon or earth spells (the boss has an earth weakness). A clean protected kill earns Avoiding Those Little Arms.

Below half HP, damaging hits can cause a burrow. Note the branch checked, run through the cave systematically and reacquire the boss. Relight a blown-out candle immediately; bugs in darkness are avoidable. Prayer must be active before resuming contact.

During the planned kills, try to finish shortly after a nearby resurface for Whack-a-Mole; a kill with at most two digs earns Why Are You Running? Both depend partly on damage/burrow luck. Do not assume a hard-diary locator.
Stop at twenty-five total kills or as soon as the global goal is met. If either three-point task is still missing, choose a reserve. Do not stay indefinitely waiting for a lucky pattern.

tasks.name: Avoiding Those Little Arms
tasks.condition: Defeat Giant Mole without her damaging any player.
tasks.tip: Protect Melee throughout; use a quiet world. Correctly protected melee is enough.

tasks.name: Why Are You Running?
tasks.condition: Win with two or fewer burrows.
tasks.tip: Chance/damage dependent. Try during the planned KC; if still missing at 25, swap rather than promise the result.

tasks.name: Whack-a-Mole
tasks.condition: Defeat Mole within ten seconds after one of her resurfacings.
tasks.tip: Pursue promptly and finish a low-HP Mole after a nearby resurface. Burrow locations are random; there is no guaranteed low-gear setup.

tasks.name: Giant Mole Novice
tasks.condition: Reach ten Giant Mole kills.
tasks.tip: Track tunnels systematically; the Falador Hard locator is optional.

tasks.name: Giant Mole Champion
tasks.condition: Reach twenty-five total Giant Mole kills.
tasks.tip: Twenty-five is a cap for this itinerary, not a rare-drop grind.

activities.label: Giant Mole

activities.title: Royal Titans · selective solo tasks
intro: Later reserve. These are demanding solo fights, and you can reach Medium without them. Use a teammate only when doing so fits your account’s prestige rules.
Separate the incompatible kill orders; do ten kills, not a forced duo speedrun.
Recommended stats: 60+ melee / Ranged, 59 Magic for both Blast spells, 43 Prayer; 70+ combat styles easier

Wear / pack: Melee armour + weapon, ranged weapon with ammo, staff + fire/water/air/death runes for Fire Blast and Water Blast, food, prayer restoration and teleport. Robes help minion accuracy; +70 magic accuracy guarantees hits on elementals, but is not an entry requirement. Avoid tank-armour negative magic bonuses when casting at minions.
steps: Enter Asgarnian Ice Dungeon south of Port Sarim and follow the western route to the boss passage. The 60 Agility shortcut/giantsoul teleport is optional. Choose solo; no duo speed task is required.

Use melee while a Titan is close and ranged when it retreats. Ranged accuracy is greatly boosted while it is out of melee reach. Pray Melee for stomps. Use Water Blast or better on fire walls and Fire Blast or better on icicles ; those obstacle casts work despite armour accuracy. Clear the targeted row and adjacent pieces.

Elementals are NPC adds, distinct from wall obstacles. They explode in a small area if left alive. Use opposite-element spells to kill them on ordinary practice attempts, or lure them into opposite-element walls/pulses for Let them fight. Metal armour can make your spells splash on minions; a robe switch helps. You do not need 75 Magic, but below that level expect more than one hit per add.

When a Titan is low enough, both move onto the platform. Avoid standing where a boss will occupy. Follow the marked safe tile for each three-blast pulse and keep ranged attacks going from safety. Do not attempt melee-between-pulses timing as a beginner.

Separate attempts: One by one requires killing one before damaging the other. It takes too long instead requires lowering both nearly to zero, waiting for a shared charge-up, then finishing both during it. Do not attempt both on the same kill.

On a no-elemental-attacks attempt, leave all adds alone and dodge/lure their explosions. Count ten destroyed by the Titans’ own opposing walls/blasts before completing the pair for Let them fight; self-detonations are not credited kills. This can take patience and need not be combined with Perfect.

On another attempt, clear all walls before natural despawn for I need room, use correct prayer and avoid all hazards for Perfect. Finish ten pairs total. Bank between visits; no 15-kill stamina restriction is in the main basket.

tasks.name: One by one
tasks.condition: Defeat one Royal Titan fully before attacking its partner.
tasks.tip: Separate attempt. This intentionally conflicts with the weaken-both setup for It takes too long.

tasks.name: Elemental Company
tasks.condition: Complete the Titans without attacking any elementals.
tasks.tip: Let bosses/walls destroy them; run away from explosions. You may cast on wall obstacles because those are not elementals.

tasks.name: Let them fight
tasks.condition: Have the Titans destroy ten elementals during one completed fight.
tasks.tip: Lure adds into opposite-element walls/blasts, counting ten actual NPC deaths. Their self-explosions do not count as Titan kills.

tasks.name: I need room
tasks.condition: Remove every fire and icicle before natural despawn during a kill.
tasks.tip: Water Blast+ on fire, Fire Blast+ on ice. Clear all rows promptly; targeted spells also remove adjacent pieces.

tasks.name: Perfect Royal Titans
tasks.condition: Complete a kill without avoidable boss/minion/hazard damage.
tasks.tip: Pray Melee for stomps; clear or avoid adds, dodge growing walls and stand on the marked pulse-safe tile.

tasks.name: It takes too long
tasks.condition: Defeat both Titans in one shared charge-up window.
tasks.tip: Weaken both to very low HP, stop attacking, then finish both while they charge. This cannot share the One by one setup.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Champion
tasks.condition: Reach ten complete Royal Titan encounters.
tasks.tip: This is ten pairs, not five pairs because there are two bosses.

tasks.name: Royal Titan Adept
tasks.condition: Reach twenty-five complete Royal Titan encounters.
tasks.tip: Use if already close or enjoying the boss; another fifteen solely for two points is slow.

tasks.name: Titan Killer
tasks.condition: Complete fifteen consecutive encounters with nobody leaving the instance.
tasks.tip: No bank reset. Joining resets streak; leaving fails it. Estimate supplies from your own observed kills first.

tasks.name: No time to pray
tasks.condition: Defeat the Titans while no Prayer points are lost.
tasks.tip: All prayers off is valid but much harder with early gear; ordinary protection use fails. Treat as an advanced alternative.

activities.label: Royal Titans

activities.title: Dagannoth Rex · seven points from the safespot
intro: Dangerous entry, simple safespot. Do not force a first entry you cannot control.
Recommended stats: 40 Ranged for rune thrownaxe and shop; 40+ Magic, 43 Prayer, 60+ HP recommended

Wear / pack: Pet rock from Askeladden (start The Fremennik Trials; no completion needed), rune thrownaxes from the Ranging Guild shop, antipoison, tank armour, earth spells + Bind/Snare runes, food, prayer potions, teleport. A rune thrownaxe’s SPECIAL clears door supports; a normal thrownaxe hit is not a substitute.
steps: Start The Fremennik Trials far enough to claim a pet rock from Askeladden outside Rellekka’s longhall. Completion is not required. With 40 Ranged, buy a few rune thrownaxes at Authentic Throwing Weapons in the Ranging Guild (about 572 coins base each). Jarvald’s Waterbirth trip costs 1,000 coins before Trials completion.

Enter Waterbirth’s west cave. Protect Melee through dagannoth; put your pet rock on one pressure pad and stand on the other to open the door. Take the northern rock-crab route. At the three door supports, use a rune thrownaxe special on the western/middle support so it ricochets through all three. Pass and descend promptly.

Use the embedded official dungeon map for the overlapping floors. After the first barrier, switch Magic for Wallasalki. Follow east/east/south/west ladders through the next rooms (the southern Bardur route is a detour), then the single onward ladder chain. Protect against each room’s attacking style; do not sprint through Wallasalki without Magic prayer.

At the final Kings ladder, drink antipoison and pray Magic before descending: Prime can hit 50. If Prime/Supreme are attacking you, immediately climb out, wait and retry. Seek a clear entry along the southern edge toward the eastern wall. Do not force a multi-king tank at low stats.

Lure Rex to the eastern-coast rock shown in the actual screenshot. Use Melee prayer while luring, then cast earth spells once he is obstructed. The image camera is rotated: its right side is north. Spinolyps can still range/poison you; maintain antipoison and eat between spawns.

At low Rex HP, land Bind/Snare and finish before it wears off for A Frozen King. Terrain does not count as a root. Reach ten and then twenty-five kills only if the long respawns are still worthwhile. Split into bank trips; teleport before poison/food exhaustion.

tasks.name: A Frozen King
tasks.condition: Defeat Rex while a successful root/freeze is still active.
tasks.tip: A rock safespot is not immobilisation. Land Bind/Snare at low HP and finish before it expires.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Rex Champion
tasks.condition: Reach ten Rex kills.
tasks.tip: Earth spells work well from the verified rock safespot.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Rex Adept
tasks.condition: Reach twenty-five Rex kills.
tasks.tip: Long respawns make the last fifteen low yield. Do not chase a berserker ring to finish this guide.

activities.label: Dagannoth Rex

activities.title: Obor · one key unlocks seven points
intro: Farm at most the first key for this basket; do not farm five chest keys.
Recommended stats: 40+ combat, 40+ Magic and 43 Prayer recommended; Bind at 20 Magic

Wear / pack: One giant key for permanent access and one chest, brass key for Edgeville shortcut, F2P armour/weapon or spells, Bind runes, food and teleport. Use a free world for Fighting as Intended; members-only equipment will not function there.
steps: If you already own a giant key, take it. Otherwise kill hill giants only up to a sensible time budget, then use a reserve if unlucky. A key has lasting access value now, but its initial drop is still RNG.

Reach Edgeville Dungeon’s hill giants via the Edgeville trapdoor or brass-key hut west of Varrock. Use the key to unlock Obor’s door permanently; it remains available for repeat attempts. Keep the key for the first loot chest.

Hop to F2P with appropriate gear and spells. Activate Protect from Missiles before descending. Snare Obor at distance, cast a few earth spells, then reposition/rebind before he reaches melee. Fight near a wall to limit knockback.
A clean distance kill can stack F2P, minimal knockback and no off-prayer damage. For Sleeping Giant, a successful root must still be active at the actual killing hit; cast the last Snare near low HP.
Loot once using the initial key for Novice. If any mechanic failed, repeat without a key. Five ordinary kills do not grant Champion; it now requires five chest openings.

tasks.name: Fighting as Intended
tasks.condition: Defeat Obor on a free-to-play world.
tasks.tip: Wear/cast only F2P items and spells. Snare is available there; verify active protection before descent.

tasks.name: Sleeping Giant
tasks.condition: Defeat Obor while a root/freeze remains active.
tasks.tip: Land the final Bind/Snare shortly before your killing cast. Rooting him earlier in the fight is not sufficient.

tasks.name: Back to the Wall
tasks.condition: Never suffer a knockback moving you more than one tile during the kill.
tasks.tip: Fight with your back to a wall; a bound, distance-kept kill that avoids knockback also works.

tasks.name: Squashing the Giant
tasks.condition: Take no damage while the relevant protection prayer is off.
tasks.tip: Bind from range with Protect Missiles; avoid melee contact while protecting ranged. Protected rock damage can be allowed.

tasks.name: Obor Novice
tasks.condition: Open Obor’s loot chest once.
tasks.tip: Spend the initial key here AFTER it has unlocked permanent boss entry. Plain unkeyed kills do not count as chest opens.

tasks.name: Obor Champion
tasks.condition: Open Obor’s chest five times.
tasks.tip: Requires five total keys, not just five kills. Use existing keys or boss-dropped ones; do not default to farming four more.

activities.label: Obor

activities.title: Bryophyta · six points without weapon poison
intro: One initial mossy key; the poison finisher and five-chest task are reserves.
Recommended stats: 40+ combat, 37 Prayer for Magic; 43 recommended for dungeon travel

Wear / pack: One mossy key, F2P axe equipped for growthlings, F2P melee/robes + combat spells, food and teleport. Antipoison for member-world attempts. Clear every members-only equipment slot when hopping to a free world.
steps: Use an existing mossy key if possible. If missing, compare time spent killing moss giants with your reserve points; never plan around five keys. Enter the Varrock sewer east of the palace and follow the western moss-giant route, cut the web and reach the lair near them.

Unlock access with the first key, which is retained until looting. Use a F2P world and F2P equipment for the easiest poison-free combination. Activate Protect from Magic, keep away from melee and cast fire spells.

When the three growthlings spawn, Bryophyta becomes immune. Let them gather close, equip an ordinary woodcutting axe and click each rapidly. Axe attacks now finish them directly; all three must die within three seconds measured from the first.

Switch back to the staff and finish while Magic prayer is active. This can earn the F2P, no-poison and prayer tasks plus Quick Cutter. Use the initial key for one chest, then repeat mechanics without more keys as necessary.
Leave the poison finishing task for an already-owned poisoned weapon on a members world. Five chest opens need five keys and are not this six-point basket.

tasks.name: Fighting as Intended II
tasks.condition: Defeat Bryophyta on a free-to-play world.
tasks.tip: Axe, Magic protection and F2P spells/equipment. This also avoids poison because she cannot poison on F2P.

tasks.name: Preparation Is Key
tasks.condition: Win without taking poison damage.
tasks.tip: The F2P attempt is the straightforward method; poison prevention, not merely curing after a tick.

tasks.name: Protection from Moss
tasks.condition: Finish Bryophyta with Protect from Magic active.
tasks.tip: Keep it on for the whole attempt for comfort, especially the final hit.

tasks.name: Quick Cutter
tasks.condition: Kill all three growthlings within three seconds of the first dying.
tasks.tip: Equip an ordinary woodcutting axe and click each rapidly after they gather. Since the 2025 change, axe attacks finish them directly.

tasks.name: Bryophyta Novice
tasks.condition: Open Bryophyta’s chest once.
tasks.tip: One initial mossy key supplies permanent access and the first chest. Repeat mechanics need no new key.

tasks.name: Bryophyta Champion
tasks.condition: Open Bryophyta’s chest five times.
tasks.tip: Five chest keys total, not five ordinary kills. Consider only already-owned keys.

tasks.name: A Slow Death
tasks.condition: Have poison or venom deliver the final damage to Bryophyta.
tasks.tip: Members world only. Poison her with an owned poisoned weapon, get HP low, stop attacking and let the poison finish.

activities.label: Bryophyta

activities.title: Reserve · Crazy Archaeologist
intro: Nine points with cheap replaceable magic gear; four need only one clean kill.
Recommended stats: 50+ Magic, 40 Prayer, 60+ HP recommended

Wear / pack: A cheap staff, robes, only enough runes/food for a short trip, prayer restoration and a level-30-or-below teleport option. Never bring your whole rune stack. Disable player-attack options and turn PK Skull Prevention on.
Opt-in Wilderness branch. Other players can kill you and take items. Use Skull Prevention, player-attack options hidden, and only equipment/runes you can replace.
steps: Bank a short-trip magic kit; carry no whole rune or cash stacks. Walk from Edgeville toward the ruins south of the Forgotten Cemetery. Check teleport restrictions: normal teleports stop above level 20 Wilderness, some jewellery works to 30; do not assume all teleports work at the boss.
Pray Missiles, attack with Magic at distance. On Rain of Knowledge, immediately run a large diagonal away from the old tile and surrounding explosions. A clean magic-only kill earns four points.

Leave/bank freely, reach ten for two more and twenty-five for three more. Prefer short trips to preserving a streak. Teleport only when within the limit; leave immediately when another player threatens.

tasks.name: Mage of the Ruins
tasks.condition: Defeat Crazy Archaeologist using Magic damage only.
tasks.tip: Cheap spell gear; Protect Missiles for normal ranged attacks. Never bring an irreplaceable upgrade to a point trip.

tasks.name: I'd Rather Not Learn
tasks.condition: Win with nobody struck by Rain of Knowledge.
tasks.tip: On the shout, run a large diagonal away from the marked original position; do not stand among neighboring explosions.

tasks.name: Crazy Archaeologist Champion
tasks.condition: Reach ten Crazy Archaeologist kills.
tasks.tip: Bank in short trips. Access is Wilderness, even though the fight itself is simple.

tasks.name: Crazy Archaeologist Adept
tasks.condition: Reach twenty-five total Crazy Archaeologist kills.
tasks.tip: The extra fifteen add three points; an owned or useful rune-crossbow drop is a bonus.

activities.label: Crazy Archaeologist

activities.title: Reserve · Chaos Fanatic
intro: Ten points, including a ten-kill no-potion streak using the Chaos Temple altar.
Recommended stats: 50+ Ranged, 37 Prayer, 60+ HP recommended

Wear / pack: Cheap bow/crossbow, replaceable ammunition, light armour, food and teleport. For Praying to the Gods, no prayer-restoring potion anywhere during the streak; restore at the altar. Wilderness death can lose items.
Opt-in Wilderness branch, with player-killing risk and teleport restrictions. Low item value does not eliminate the risk of losing time and supplies.
steps: Take a cheap ranged kit to the Chaos Fanatic southwest of the Lava Maze. Pray Magic. On green explosion projectiles, run away from the old target and adjacent splashes; never stand still just because Prayer is on.
A clean kill earns the no-explosion task. Ten kills and twenty-five total add their KC points.

For Praying to the Gods, do ten kills without leaving the Wilderness or drinking any prayer-restoring potion. Restore at the nearby Chaos Temple altar between kills, take enough food, and watch for other players. A bank trip breaks the visit condition; a prayer potion invalidates it. Do not carry a forbidden dose next to food if misclicking is likely.

activities.title: Reserve · use an already-owned dark totem
intro: Six points from one suitable kill; never farm a totem solely for this route.
Recommended stats: 60+ melee / Magic and 43 Prayer; one full dark totem

Wear / pack: Dark totem, melee/magic gear, demonbane weapon (Darklight/Silverlight acceptable when equipped for the finishing hit), food, prayer potions and teleport. Arclight is helpful if already owned, not mandatory.
steps: Use an already-owned full dark totem on the altar in the Catacombs’ centre. Bring a demonbane weapon and enough supplies; the totem is consumed for the attempt.

Fight with Melee prayer close up or Magic protection when standing at distance. Watch the four corner altars: destroy active ones so the boss is not protected by multiple altars. Return to the boss and repeat.

Near death, stop damage, deactivate every lit altar, equip your demonbane weapon and finish before another altar activates. A correctly timed kill can give all three two-point tasks. Do not farm totems merely to add this chapter.

intro: Optional solo reserve for existing Farming progression. Weed Whacker, Hespori Adept and Hesporisn’t are separate three-point tasks.

Visit the cave to read your patch. Open the Hespori checklist for its last observed status and your seed supply. Enable reminders for an optional notification when it may be time to check or replant.
steps: Use an already-grown Hespori at 65 Farming in the Farming Guild’s west cave. Bring a fast ranged weapon and adequate poison protection/food.

When the four flowers open, click all four rapidly with the fast weapon; each dies to one hit. Kill them within five seconds. The task awards without a full Hespori kill, so leave after the popup if the remaining fight is not wanted.
Obtain Hespori seeds through your normal Farming, then plant one in the Farming Guild cave and wait for it to mature. Bring a spade; the seed is not an immediate fight unlock.
Attack each of the four flowers with a fast ranged weapon when they open. Swap to melee on Hespori, step away from roots promptly and cure poison. Keep an escape available.
Do the special-finish and no-Prayer attempts separately while learning. Do not rely on an unobserved crop, another group member’s seed, or a speed-task completion before the actual game award.
For Hesporisn’t, take a dragon dagger or another suitable damaging special weapon. Reserve special energy and use the special for the final damage.

preparation.text: The working itinerary assumes an early member Ironman around 60 Attack/Strength/Defence, 50–60 Ranged, 59 Magic, 43 Prayer and 60+ HP , with basic bought/crafted gear. These are recommendations, not a universal access requirement. Brutus, Wintertodt and Tempoross are available much earlier. Level 59 Magic matters for clearing Royal Titan obstacles; 60 Attack + Lost City is the simple Barrows special-weapon route.

Varlamore adds a 48 Slayer quest gate. Amoxliatl also needs 55 Mining, 48 Thieving and 46 Agility. If those are far away, postpone that phase and compare the reserve route. There is no efficient universal starting total of training hours: a new level-3 account has substantially more preparation than an early account already in the 60s.
Acquisition references: Rune mace · Jukat · Clue hunter outfit · Light sources · Prayer potion

Quest preparation · compact walkthroughs and exact gates Skip every completed quest. Time ranges below exclude missing skill training. The account panel records completion, while these instructions remain available offline. The Ides of Milk · no requirements · about 15–25 minutes Talk to Cassius beside the pond south of Lumbridge windmill. Talk to Gillie in the cow field, then Seth in the chicken-coop house northwest; search his south shelves for The Groats Principles. Bring the book to Cassius, drink his sample and speak again. Visit Duke Horacio upstairs in the castle about the permit. Return to Gillie, drink the second sample in front of her, then agree to deal with the bull through the northeastern pen gate. Dodge growl charges sideways and snort slams backward/sideways; specials can kill even though the quest bull’s normal hits are forgiving. After victory, speak to Gillie, confront Cassius and return to Gillie for cowbell/lamp rewards. The post-quest repeat boss is separate KC. Quest source Silverlight / anti-dragon shield · small circuit prerequisites For Demon Slayer’s Silverlight: speak to Aris in Varrock Square, then Sir Prysin in the palace. Get one key from Captain Rovin at the palace tower; another by pouring water into the palace kitchen drain and retrieving it in the sewer; the third from Wizard Traiborn in Wizards’ Tower in exchange for 25 bones after his dialogue. Return three keys to Prysin, obtain Silverlight, and learn your own five-word incantation from Aris. At the stone circle south of Varrock, fight Delrith with Silverlight and choose that incantation when weakened. Keep Silverlight for a demon finisher. To obtain an anti-dragon shield conventionally, start Dragon Slayer I at the Champions’ Guild with 32 Quest Points, speak to Oziach as directed, then ask Duke Horacio in Lumbridge for the shield. Finishing Dragon Slayer is unnecessary merely to use it. If this is a large missing detour, skip the one-point black dragon and replace it. Demon Slayer · Shield Priest in Peril · no skills · about 15–35 minutes Bring melee/ranged gear (the guardian is immune to Magic), food, bucket and 50 unnoted rune/pure essence. Roald in Varrock Palace sends you to Paterdomus east of Varrock. Try the temple door; descend the northern trapdoor and kill the guardian. Return to Roald, then the temple; kill the hooded level-30 monk for a golden key. Climb the northeast stairs and southwest ladder to Drezel’s cell. At the underground well, study monuments to find the iron-key monument and exchange the golden key there. Fill your bucket at the well. Use the iron key on Drezel’s door, ask him to bless the water, pour it on the nearby coffin and speak again. Meet him through the mausoleum’s northeast gate and deliver 50 essence across bank trips. After receiving quest rewards, speak again for his passage blessing . Monks are aggressive in the current quest. If essence is missing: Rune Mysteries runs Duke Horacio → Sedridor in Wizards’ Tower basement → Aubury’s Varrock shop → Sedridor. Thereafter Aubury teleports you to mine essence with a pickaxe. This is a supply option, not a formal Priest requirement. Quest · Quick guide Bone Voyage chain · Dig Site + 100 Kudos · substantial if starting from nothing Druidic Ritual, if Herblore is locked: take raw beef, chicken, rat and bear meat to Kaqemeex at Taverley’s stone circle, then Sanfew upstairs in the herb shop. Descend Taverley Dungeon, pass the armour-guarded gate and use each meat on the Cauldron of Thunder. Return to Sanfew, then Kaqemeex. Train to 10 Herblore for Dig Site. Dig Site: 10 Agility, 10 Herblore, 25 Thieving. Bring pestle/mortar, vial, tinderbox, tea, two ropes, opal and charcoal if owned. Examiner south of the site → Museum curator for letter → examiner. Help three students: teddy from the second bush east of the blue urn, special cup from panning after giving the guide tea, skull/brush from pickpocketing a workman. Return each item, ask each student for help, then take three exams, returning for help between them; give the blonde student an opal before the third. Exam answers: earth/contents/history; qualified people; gloves/boots/proper tools. Next: rough samples/sealed containers; gloves; strike cleaving point. Last: cleaned samples/jars; slow short brush strokes; bones separate/careful. With trowel/brush/specimen jar, dig level-3 soil for a talisman; show Terry Balando for invitation. Show a workman by the winch. Rope western winch, take arcenia root and inspect blocking bricks. Rope northeast winch, ask Doug for a chest key. Southern-tent chest gives powder; open nearby barrel with trowel, fill vial with liquid. Terry identifies both. Mix liquid + powder + ground charcoal + root; use compound, then tinderbox on the western underground bricks. Retrieve tablet and show Terry. Never drop the liquid. 100 Kudos: first report existing quests to Historian Minas. A common basket is 28 museum-basement quiz + 50 finds + five 5-Kudos quest reports = 103. Orlando Smith begins the quiz; do all 14 plaques and return to him. After Dig Site, wear the processing room’s leather gloves/boots, take its tools, clean finds and show the archaeologist. Place pottery in case 22, old symbol 36, ancient symbol 37, ancient coin 44, old coin 45. Necklace is optional. Choose five reports from quests already done, such as Rune Mysteries, Priest in Peril, Demon Slayer, Hazeel Cult and Merlin’s Crystal; missing quests add real time. Fossils cannot solve your first unlock because Fossil Island itself needs Bone Voyage. Bone Voyage: bring two vodka and a marrentill potion (unf), not finished antipoison. Curator → barge foreman → Lumber Yard sawmill operator → Woodcutting Guild eastern gate/operator (trying the gate works without 60 Woodcutting) → Lumber Yard → barge. Lead Navigator → Jack Seagull in Port Sarim → navigator → Odd Old Man north of Digsite for bone charm → Varrock Apothecary with ingredients, repeat dialogue for Sealegs. Give Sealegs to lead and charm to junior. Steer opposite the upper heading arrow’s drift and recenter; reduce sail if struggling. On arrival disembark. An optional bank chest needs 21 Construction, iron bar, two oak planks, five nails and hammer. Dig Site · Quick guide · Kudos · Bone Voyage Museum quiz answer bank · all 14 exhibits Use the correct-option phrases below to match the question being asked. Each exhibit needs three correct answers; the six possible answers are listed so random question selection does not require another lookup. Return to Orlando after all displays. Choose Chop on the nearby tree northwest to reveal Shamus and ask about Zanaris. Bank all armour, weapons and staves before the Entrana boat; bring knife, combat-spell runes, food and a permitted emergency teleport. Descend the Cave Monk’s dungeon, kill zombies with manual Magic until a bronze axe drops, then try chopping the Dramen Tree southeast. Lure the level-101 Tree Spirit behind the southern fungus within its own room and kill with Magic. Chop a branch, use knife to make a dramen staff, teleport out, equip it and enter the central Lumbridge Swamp shed. The dungeon’s magic door exits into level-32 Wilderness, so use your own teleport. Jukat sells the dragon weapons; they are not free quest rewards. Fairy rings require additional quests. Quest source Varlamore entry · Children of the Sun + Twilight’s Promise Children: talk to Noah/Alina behind Eliza’s stall east of Varrock Square. Follow the suspicious guard southeast, hiding at Lowe’s shop, the building south of it and Yarlo’s house as he turns. Return to Sergeant Tobyn and identify four impostors: hands-on-hips unarmed guard by Aris; helmetless woman by Benny; crossed-arms unarmed guard by Lowe; mace guard between Lowe and the east bank. Return to Tobyn, finish the interrogation and speak again. Regulus outside the east gate offers Varlamore passage. No skills/items/combat required. Twilight: bring food and two combat styles. Tullus twins at Sunrise Palace → Metzli southeast of bazaar → Itzla downstairs → twins for crest. Recruit knights: Arrun/Claudia need a citizen-pickpocketed amulet; Nel at docks needs the northeastern crate by two fish barrels and ship name Fortis Spark; Mezan at Colosseum needs sparring with attack-style switches around his four-hit protection changes; lead Azali from tavern to eastern fountain, then talk Velam (dismiss followers first). Return to twins. Search the southeast bedroom chests two floors up at Kualti Headquarters, read the letter, return. Ask Regulus southeast of palace about Teomat, feed Renu, fly, talk Itzla by altar and Metzli in library. Survive cultists/cutscene. Quetzal transport opens. Children · Twilight Perilous Moons · 48 Slayer, 20 Hunter/Fishing/Runecraft, 10 Construction Twilight’s Promise required; 38 Herblore/30 Cooking make the local supplies practical. At Cam Torum gate talk Zuma/Attala, find and kill the escaped Sulphur Nagua at the outflow spring (Protect Melee); return and enter town. Go north to Jessamine/ruins, speak Attala → Zuma → Jessamine. Take hammer/saw/three supplies and build camps in Earthbound northwest, Streambound northeast and Ancient Prison southwest (Melee prayer near Nagua). Return to Jessamine for talismans; Attala → Nahta at town’s runic shop → northeastern blacksmith → Attala. Use east-west/north-south pulling talismans to locate the random row/column intersection and reveal Eyatlalli; return to the group. Collect/grind a moonlight grub in Streambound, net a bream and knife its scales; in Earthbound set a rope trap between paired rocks, rustle bushes, knife the caught lizard for a tail. Return to Attala/Eyatlalli with ritual items, defeat the three Moons using the chapter mechanics, then speak to Attala, Zuma, Jessamine and Eyatlalli. Loot the lunar chest via Streambound’s southeastern passage. Check actual CA counters after the quest. Quest · Quick guide The Heart of Darkness · 55 Mining, 48 Thieving/Slayer, 46 Agility Twilight’s Promise required. Bring 30 coins, melee kit, food, Prayer supplies and pickaxe. Itzla at Teomat → Windbreaker in Quetzacalli Gorge, rent/rest in east bed → disguised Itzla → eastern shopkeeper/cult → Itzla → Tower of Ascension. Talk four recruits and prince.
